# Decision map (generated by experiments/w3_decision_map.py)

V, levels in $M; rel = V / M0 (no-forecast cost); N = share of a level's report probability with d_info < 0; N_tol = heuristic tolerance version (d_info < -1e-4 J_nosig). Policy columns (forecast-aware plan, owned GE+DG+BESS in MW, planner law): C_pre = ordered before the estimate; O_surv = expected orders still to be placed given the campus waits at the estimate quarter; O = O_surv / (C_pre + O_surv); ns_O = same share for the no-forecast plan; S_GE = spread across categories of expected GE still to be ordered (MW); sw_GE = share of cells with S_GE >= one 4.455 MW unit; O_cum = secondary metric (category-weighted cumulative post-estimate spine orders). Averages: within-level normalized report weights, then the mean of the two levels.
